description:
Chaser is a Slack-native task management and project tracking app. Connect Chaser to ChatGPT or Codex to find, create, update, complete, reopen, acknowledge, delete, and log time on tasks without leaving your AI conversation.

Changes sync back to Slack, where Chaser keeps assignees and followers up to date. Use it to turn meeting notes into assigned tasks, review overdue work, summarize workloads, and create custom reports from live task data.

defaultPrompt: Turn these meeting notes into tasks and assign them to me.
Show me every task related to a bug that's overdue right now.
Summarize what Sarah has on her plate this week.
